d22: No prompt body is stored here. Each operation names its span by a start and an end anchor of at most 15 words; body_check.py resolves the exact span on a transient read of the live page.
span_rule: The span starts at the single occurrence of `start` and ends at the end of the first occurrence of `end` at or after the end of `start`, on the same line. When `end` is null the span is `start` itself. `start` must occur exactly once in the page, and `new` must not occur in it before landing.
